summary: Candidate is a distinct micro_skill in concurrency_control_optimization domain (pre_validation stage, early_validation method) with no semantic overlap to existing skills. Existing skills are in unrelated domains (metrics_instrumentation, stream_execution_tuning). Peer candidates (Lock-Free Tuple Read, Read-Set Validation, Read Timestamp Extension) are complementary skills in the same validation workflow but operate at different stages/methods and do not subsume this preemptive abort decision logic. Support evidence from section 4.1 validates the capability.
